threat_event: Compromise of the shared integration platform reaches rail Critical Cyber Systems and exposes personal information of all divisions
threat_source: Cybercriminal or state-sponsored group exploiting the managed file transfer component
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: SYS-G5 connects the TMS interface server, the TOS, the ERP, and the property system; its flow into the DMZ is not in the CIP; HR export files are never purged; 14 partner credentials older than 1 year
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-G5; SYS-R4; TDPB industrial DMZ; SYS-G4 HR exports
existing_controls: Platform patched on a 14-day critical cycle; SOC monitoring; DMZ firewall in front of the TMS interface server
treatment_plan: File a CIP amendment request with the SYS-G5 flows; dedicated DMZ rule and inspection; purge HR exports after transfer; rotate partner credentials

threat_event: Ransomware spreads through shared services into the dispatch back office, terminals, and corporate systems at once
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared identity and network connect all divisions; 21 acquired terminals on flat networks without EDR; unreviewed OT directory trust
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-G1; SYS-G3; TDPB; SYS-W1; SYS-W2; SYS-G4
existing_controls: 24x7 SOC; EDR on 96% of IT endpoints; immutable backups; industrial DMZ for the railroads
treatment_plan: Segment and onboard the acquired terminals; review and remove the OT directory trust; cross-division ransomware tabletop (P08)

threat_event: A cross-division incident misses TSA, CISA, SEC, state, or contract notice clocks
threat_source: Process failure during a multi-division incident
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Division playbooks are separate; the group notification matrix has never been exercised; the TSOC procedure covers only the 14 Covered Railroads
affected_asset_or_process: Group incident response and disclosure process
regulatory_driver: C-TRANSPORTATION-R01 (SD 1580-21-01E II.C); C-TRANSPORTATION-S01 (49 CFR 1570.203); C-TRANSPORTATION-S10; C-TRANSPORTATION-S07
existing_controls: CISA reporting procedure for Covered Railroads; disclosure committee charter
treatment_plan: One group notification matrix (P08); TSOC procedure for all 72 railroads; cross-division tabletop with the disclosure committee

threat_event: AI used in safety inspections, pricing, or lease decisions without adequate validation or oversight
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Defect detection validated on Class I data; pricing model and lease abstraction tool live before the AI Standard
existing_controls: Group AI Standard; council approval for high-tier use; inspectors decide on every alert
treatment_plan: Group AI governance program (P10): short line validation for AI-001; council review of the 6 unreviewed use cases

threat_event: Payment fraud through vendor bank changes or rent redirection drains funds across divisions
threat_source: Business email compromise and social engineering groups
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Call-back verification not enforced in the ERP for 3 of 7 accounts payable teams; $2.3 million lost in 2025
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-G4 vendor master and payments; SYS-E1 tenant remittance instructions
existing_controls: Dual approval for wires; email security; awareness training
treatment_plan: Enforce call-back verification in the ERP workflow for all teams; bank account validation service; tenant notice that remittance details never change by email

threat_event: Divisions without policy supplements apply group policy inconsistently to terminal and building OT
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Only the Freight Railroad division has a supplement; no written OT standards for terminals or buildings
affected_asset_or_process: Transload and Wholesale and Real Estate control environments
existing_controls: Group policies POL-01 to POL-05 apply everywhere
treatment_plan: Issue division supplements with terminal OT and building OT standards (P06)

threat_event: Controls assumed to be inherited from corporate do not operate in two divisions
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Inheritance documented only for the railroads; terminals and buildings sit partly outside the platform
treatment_plan: Inheritance matrices for both divisions; confirm each year

threat_event: A critical third party fails or is breached and stops operations in more than one division
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: PTC vendor certifies patches slowly; single crew calling telephony provider; building OT vendors without security terms; 17 of 160 tier-1 vendor reviews overdue
affected_asset_or_process: PTC back office; crew calling; SYS-E2; SYS-G5 vendor
existing_controls: Tiered third-party program; SOC report reviews
treatment_plan: Clear overdue reviews; contract terms for patch timelines and security; second telephony provider tested

threat_event: Sensitive Security Information is disclosed to people without a need to know
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: CIP, CAP report, and hazmat security plan in a share readable by 340 users across all divisions; right-of-way drawings shared with licensees
existing_controls: SSI training for rail security staff; screening of right-of-way documents
treatment_plan: Restricted SSI library with access by named role; purge copies; SSI marking check

threat_event: Unknown OT assets in rail, terminal, and building networks are exploited or missed in an incident
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Rail field inventory 86% complete; no central terminal OT or building OT inventory
existing_controls: Rail OT inventory tool; passive sensors at both NOCs
treatment_plan: Extend the inventory tool and passive sensors to terminals and buildings; finish rail field inventory

threat_event: A privileged insider in shared services misuses access across divisions
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared services administrators can reach all divisions
existing_controls: PAM with session recording; background checks; quarterly certification
treatment_plan: Extend user behavior analytics to PAM sessions

threat_event: Acquired businesses join the group below its security baseline or change TSA applicability unnoticed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 21 terminals still outside the baseline 9 to 24 months after closing; no TSA applicability step in the acquisition checklist (1570.105(b))
treatment_plan: Security baseline gate in the integration playbook; TSA applicability and CIP amendment steps for any rail acquisition

threat_event: Breach of employee, driver, or guarantor personal information triggers notices in many states
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Personal information in HR exports on SYS-G5, the crew system, fleet telematics, and the property system
existing_controls: Encryption at rest; access control; SOC monitoring
treatment_plan: Data minimization in transfers; purge rules; breach procedure in P08

threat_event: A state-sponsored actor pre-positions in rail OT to disrupt operations during a crisis
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: OT log coverage 58%; CTC and PTC servers keep local logs for 30 days; OT directory trust unreviewed
existing_controls: Industrial DMZ; passive OT sensors at NOCs; threat intelligence from CISA and TSA
treatment_plan: Forward CTC and PTC logs with 1-year retention; OT threat hunts twice a year; remove the directory trust

threat_event: A major hurricane disables the Jacksonville headquarters, primary NOC, and DC-1
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Primary NOC and DC-1 on one campus in Florida
existing_controls: Backup NOC and DC-2 outside Florida; annual failover
treatment_plan: Pre-season relocation drill for dispatchers; PTC failover fix (RR-003)

threat_event: The group misstates its cybersecurity program or files a late Form 8-K
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Item 106 text not reconciled with P01 and P03 results
treatment_plan: Reconcile the next Item 106 disclosure with these results; include the disclosure committee in the tabletop

threat_event: A cloud provider region outage stops the TMS, TOS, and integration platform
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Provider A region hosts the TMS, TOS, and SYS-G5 in one region with zone redundancy only
existing_controls: Zone redundancy; RSSM extract at both NOCs; paper workarounds
treatment_plan: Accepted at Low; revisit when the integration platform is redesigned

threat_event: Loss of scarce OT security staff weakens rail and terminal controls
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: OT security knowledge sits with a small team
